This is not about politics. This is about protecting our country.


Andrew Solender (@AndrewSolender)

NEW: Raskin, w/ 50 House Dem co-sponsors, formally introduces a bill which would create a commission to assess Trump's fitness for office under the 25th Amendment.

Bill text here: documentcloud.org/documents/…

Story TK









— https://nitter.net/AndrewSolender/status/2044084208771952805#m
It was an honor to speak with students and faculty at UCLA last week about policies targeting LGBTQ+ people. Every person deserves dignity and safety.
Wishing a joyful Vaisakhi to all who celebrate! May this festival bring prosperity and new beginnings.

If the president forces Republicans to vote for a budget that cuts health care and vital services to fund this unconstitutional war, that would be a political extinction-level event for Republicans in Congress.

Video

Friendly reminder: Republicans continue to block our efforts to lower healthcare costs.


PBS News (@NewsHour)

About 8 in 10 Americans who re-enrolled in Affordable Care Act marketplace coverage say their health care costs are higher this year, including about half who say their costs are "a lot" higher, according to a survey from the health care research nonprofit KFF. 
to.pbs.org/47HpDOI




— https://nitter.net/NewsHour/status/2043630778597192141#m
Trump’s budget would cut NASA’s science budget by nearly 50% …

Black women are nearly 3 times more likely than white women to die from pregnancy-related complications.

This is unacceptable.

House Democrats are working hard to pass the #Momnibus to save moms’ lives and put an end to the maternal health crisis.

“I thought it was me as a doctor.” – Trump


The Washington Post (@washingtonpost)

In a now-deleted post, President Trump shared a rendering that appeared to depict him as Jesus on Monday, drawing rare criticism from the religious right and allegations of blasphemy. wapo.st/4stvtL2





— https://nitter.net/washingtonpost/status/2043721101960736792#m

6 million Jewish people were murdered during the Holocaust. On Yom HaShoah, we honor their memory.

It is our responsibility to fight back against antisemitism, violence, and hatred in all forms. Never again.
Even Justin Bieber couldn’t save this lineup.

Native Hawaiians are five times more likely to die from pregnancy and childbirth. Puerto Ricans face disproportionately high asthma rates. Black Americans are over 10% more likely to die from cancer than white Americans.

These disparities are preventable.

During National Minority Health Month, we recommit to closing these health care gaps.

Trump wants to increase the White House renovation budget by $338 million after his One Big Beautiful Bill Act made the largest cut to Medicaid in history…

politico.com/news/2026/04/03…

Asian American, Native Hawaiian, & Pacific Islander women earn just 83 cents for every dollar a white man makes.

Equal pay deserves equal work. It’s time to close the gap.

To fund more war, Trump’s budget proposal would cut:

$10.7 billion for housing

$8.5 billion for K-12 programs

$2.5 billion for clean drinking water

Not happening.

What the president is doing is batshit crazy.

Video

Our annual Service Academy Day gives prospective service academy students and their parents the opportunity to speak with representatives from service academies and ask questions about the admissions process.

Meeting so many bright young people who want to serve their country is a true honor.

To learn more about attending a U.S. Service Academy, please visit lieu.house.gov/services

Not voting for a single additional penny for this illegal war with Iran.

Video

Our veterans deserve better than this.


ProPublica (@propublica)

The VA lost about 700 social workers and 500 psychologists and psychiatrists over the course of 2025 — a significant change for an agency that was adding mental health staffers nearly every month leading up to Trump’s return to office.
propublica.org/article/veter…




— https://nitter.net/propublica/status/2040957689627279462#m

In the richest country in the world, no one should have to choose between feeding their families and accessing health care.


60 Minutes (@60Minutes)

About one third of Americans say they have skipped meals, borrowed money, or cut back on utilities to pay for health care. That's in a Gallup poll released in March. cbsn.ws/3NMI7H7




— https://nitter.net/60Minutes/status/2040942562383438286#m
The time to do something is now, and we must act.
